card.name: Percent figures after patient counts
card.fires_on: The comma, opening parenthesis or decimal point right after a count like 25 of 387, just before a percentage in clinical-trial results. It expects the percentage and then the word patients.

modes.label: Parenthesis before percent
modes.description: The opening bracket after an n of N count, before the percentage value.
modes.example: hallucinations (visual or auditory or mixed) were reported in 25 of 387<< (>>6%) patients treated with pramip

modes.description: The decimal point inside a small percentage or proportion in trial tables.

card.writes: It pushes toward the word people or patients after the percentage, with weak and mixed effects otherwise.
card.plain: It fires where a trial report gives a count of patients and is about to give the percentage.
